destinationType.title: Destination Type
destinationType.description: The JMS destination type (queue or topic).

maxSessionsPerConnection.title: Max Session Per Connection
maxSessionsPerConnection.description: The maximum number of pooled sessions per connection in the pool.

maxIdleSessionsPerConnection.title: Max Idle Sessions Per Connection
maxIdleSessionsPerConnection.description: The number of idle sessions allowed per connection before they are closed.

connectionIdleTimeout.title: Connection Idle Timeout
connectionIdleTimeout.description: The maximum time a pooled Connection can sit unused before it is eligible for removal (in milliseconds).
